Name: App
Doc:
App owns one application runtime, one main window and any child windows. An
App is single-use: Run may be called exactly once.

Name: LayoutContext
Doc:
LayoutContext is the logical space available to the root builder. It
contains no backend values. A constraint-aware build runs once initially
and once for the final resize/scale event in each drained event batch.
Code: type LayoutContext struct{ Width, Height float32 }

Name: NewApp
Doc: NewApp creates an application configuration without loading SDL.

Name: App.RunResponsive
Doc:
RunResponsive is Run with a root builder that may choose a different view
structure from the current logical window size. Measuring a result never
invokes the builder again; only a later coalesced viewport event can do so.

Name: App.Run
Doc:
Run creates the native window, builds root, and owns the process main thread
until the app closes. Call it directly from main, before moving UI work to
other goroutines. Run is blocking and may be called only once, including
after a startup or runtime error. A nil root is rejected before the App is
consumed. Startup, build, renderer, callback, and event-loop failures are
returned; OnError also observes runtime failures when configured.

Name: App.SetTheme
Doc:
SetTheme validates and copies a complete Primitive -> Semantic -> Component
theme atomically. Equal themes are a no-op. A relevant metric-token change
schedules layout; visual-only resolved changes schedule display/paint only.
While Run is active, call SetTheme from a UI callback or inside Update.

Name: App.SetClipboardText
Doc:
SetClipboardText writes UTF-8 text to the system clipboard. While Run is
active, call it from a UI callback or inside Update so the native operation
remains on the UI thread. Invalid UTF-8 is normalized to replacement runes.

Name: App.Close
Doc:
Close requests application shutdown and safely wakes a blocked event wait.
It may be called from callbacks or any goroutine. Repeated calls and calls
made before Run are no-ops.

Name: App.Update
Doc:
Update queues a state update for FIFO execution on the UI thread, then
rebuilds the root once after the batch. It never executes update on the
caller's goroutine and is safe to call from any goroutine.

Name: App.Invalidate
Doc:
Invalidate requests a rebuild of the main window only. It is safe from any
goroutine; child windows use Window.Invalidate.

Name: App.Diagnostics
Doc: Diagnostics returns a race-safe, SDL-free runtime snapshot.

Name: Assign
Doc:
Assign returns a callback that stores its argument in target. It is intended
for simple controlled UI callbacks. Assign panics when target is nil; it does
not schedule work or replace App.Update for cross-goroutine mutation.

Name: ScrollAxis
Doc:
ScrollAxis selects the axes whose content is measured without a maximum
and whose retained offset may change.

Name: ScrollVertical
ScrollbarPolicy
Doc:
ScrollbarPolicy controls the overlay scrollbar. Hidden suppresses scrollbar
paint and pointer interaction without disabling wheel/trackpad scrolling.

Name: ScrollbarAuto
ScrollProps
Doc:
ScrollProps configures a one-child clipped viewport. Offset is authoritative
when set. Otherwise InitialOffset is used only when the view is first
mounted; later positions are preserved while the view keeps its identity.
OnScroll reports the complete offset. Without Offset, movement updates
retained state even with a nil callback; with Offset it only proposes a
change. Scroll has no Disabled or ReadOnly property.

type ScrollProps struct {
	Key           string
	Style         Style
	Token         ComponentToken
	States        StateStyles
	Pointer       PointerBehavior
	Axis          ScrollAxis

	OnScroll func(Point)
}

Name: VirtualListProps
Doc:
VirtualListProps configures a vertical, fixed-row-height virtual list.
Count and Version identify one immutable data snapshot; increment Version
whenever row keys or content may have changed. ItemKey and Build run on the
UI thread and must be deterministic and side-effect free for that snapshot.
Code:
type VirtualListProps struct {
	Key           string
	Style         Style
	Token         ComponentToken
	States        StateStyles
	Pointer       PointerBehavior

	Version       uint64

	InitialOffset Option[Point]
	Offset        Option[Point]
	Scrollbar     ScrollbarPolicy

	Build         func(index int) View
	OnScroll      func(Point)
}

Name: TextWrap
Doc: TextWrap selects the MVP simple wrapping policy.

Name: TextProps
Doc:
TextProps configures simple left-to-right text. Invalid UTF-8 is normalized
to U+FFFD when Text is constructed. TextWrapWords collapses whitespace and
wraps only at word boundaries; it is not Unicode line-break conformance.

Name: ButtonGroupProps
Doc:
ButtonGroupProps configures a non-focusable connected container of Button
views.

Name: InputGroupProps

InputGroupProps configures the non-focusable visual container around one
Input and its optional leading and trailing content.

	Key     string
	Style   Style
	Token   ComponentToken

	Pointer PointerBehavior
}

Name: InputGroupContent
Doc:
InputGroupContent identifies the required Input and optional adornments.
Prefix and Suffix may contain passive views or Buttons; other focusable
controls and nested text editors are rejected.

Name: BadgeProps
Doc:
BadgeProps configures a compact, non-interactive label around one arbitrary
child. The child inherits the Badge text/icon tint unless locally overridden.
Code:
type BadgeProps struct {
	Key     string
	Style   Style
	Token   ComponentToken
	States  StateStyles
	Pointer PointerBehavior
}

Name: ProgressBarProps
Doc:
ProgressBarProps configures a deterministic, non-interactive progress
indicator. Value is clamped to [0,1] for painting. NaN and negative
infinity paint empty; positive infinity paints complete.

	Token   ComponentToken
	States  StateStyles

}

Name: PathVerb
Doc:
PathVerb identifies one command in dxui's deliberately small vector icon
format. It is not an SVG parser or a general scene graph.

Name: PathMove

Doc:

Points[0:2], and Cubic uses all three points.

Name: Rect
Doc: Rect is a rectangle in logical units.

Name: IconData
Doc: IconData is immutable dxui path data in ViewBox coordinates.

Name: IconStrokeWidth
Doc:
IconStrokeWidth is a stroke width in icon view-box units. Zero selects the
Lucide default of 2. It affects immutable stroked resources and is ignored
by legacy filled IconData.

Name: IconProps
Doc:
IconProps configures a vector icon. Size is measured in logical units; zero
uses the current component theme default.

Name: ToggleSwitchProps
SliderProps
Doc:
SliderProps configures a controlled single-value horizontal slider. Value
is authoritative; OnChange receives a clamped, step-aligned proposal. Zero
Min and Max select the default 0..100 range. Step defaults to 1 when it is
non-positive or non-finite. Other invalid ranges are inert.

Name: CheckboxProps

Name: RadioProps
Doc:
RadioProps configures a controlled radio button. Selected is authoritative;
OnSelect is called only when an enabled, unselected Radio is activated.

Name: ImageSource
Doc: ImageSource is an immutable, comparable handle to application image data.

Name: ImageBytes
Doc: ImageBytes copies encoded PNG, JPEG, or GIF bytes immediately.

Name: ImageFile
Doc: ImageFile records a path that is read by the image engine on demand.

Name: ImageFromGo
Doc: ImageFromGo records an immutable-by-contract Go image source.

Name: ImageFit
Doc: ImageFit selects the supported destination fitting policy.

Name: ImageContain
ImageProps

Name: AvatarShape
Doc: AvatarShape selects the fixed Avatar clipping shape.

Name: AvatarProps
Doc:
AvatarProps configures a square, centered cover image. Size is measured in
logical units; zero uses the current component theme default. Explicit Style
width and height take precedence.

Name: TextRange
Doc: TextRange uses Unicode code-point (rune) offsets, never UTF-8 byte offsets.
Code: type TextRange struct{ Start, End int }

Name: InputProps
Doc:
InputProps configures a controlled single-line input. OnChange receives the
complete proposed value after committed text, paste, cut, deletion, undo, or
redo. The application accepts the edit by returning that value from the next
build; leaving Value unchanged rejects it. IME composition does not call
OnChange. Selection and TextRange use rune indices. A nil OnChange makes the
input read-only by behavior, without Disabled styling. ReadOnly also blocks
pre-edit; focus, selection, non-password copy, and OnSubmit remain available.

Name: TextareaProps
Doc:
TextareaProps configures a controlled multiline editor and follows the same
controlled Value and rune-indexed selection contract as Input. TextWrapWords
is a simple LTR/CJK word-wrap policy, not full Unicode line breaking. A nil
OnChange preserves navigation, selection, copy, and scrolling without edits
or pre-edit; it does not imply Disabled styling.

Name: SelectOption
Doc:
SelectOption is one immutable entry in a Select. Value must be non-empty and
unique within the Select; it is both the controlled application value and
the stable identity used when options reorder.

Name: SelectProps
Doc:
SelectProps configures a controlled custom popup Select. Value is
authoritative; an empty or unmatched Value displays Placeholder.
Code:
type SelectProps struct {
	Key         string
	Style       Style
	Token       ComponentToken
	States      StateStyles
	Pointer     PointerBehavior
	Value       string
	Options     []SelectOption
	Placeholder string
	// Disabled closes the popup, cancels interaction, and removes the focus stop.
	Disabled bool
	// OnChange proposes Value. Nil still allows popup browsing, navigation, and dismissal.
	OnChange func(string)
}

Name: OverlayPlacement
Doc:
OverlayPlacement selects the preferred side and alignment of a window-level
overlay. Placement automatically flips to the opposite side when it has
more usable room and the preferred side cannot fit the content.

Name: OverlayBottomStart
Code:
const (
	OverlayBottomStart OverlayPlacement = iota
	OverlayBottom
	OverlayBottomEnd
	OverlayTopStart
	OverlayTop
	OverlayTopEnd
	OverlayLeft
	OverlayRight
)

Name: PopoverProps
Doc:
PopoverProps configures a controlled, interactive window-level overlay.
Open is authoritative. Anchor activation, Escape, and an outside primary
click submit the proposed state through OnOpenChange. Nil leaves Open
unchanged and preserves open-content interaction. There is no Disabled or
ReadOnly property; an anchor child does not disable the Popover host.
Code:
type PopoverProps struct {
	Key       string
	Style     Style
	Token     ComponentToken
	States    StateStyles
	Pointer   PointerBehavior
	Open      bool
	Placement OverlayPlacement
	Offset    MetricValue
	// OnOpenChange proposes Open. Nil leaves Open unchanged; open content remains interactive.
	OnOpenChange func(bool)
}

Name: TooltipProps
Doc:
TooltipProps configures a non-interactive window-level hint. Hovering or
keyboard-focusing the anchor starts Delay; leaving both closes it. A zero
Delay selects the built-in 500 ms default.
Code:
type TooltipProps struct {
	Key       string
	Style     Style
	Token     ComponentToken
	States    StateStyles
	Pointer   PointerBehavior
	Placement OverlayPlacement
	Offset    MetricValue
	Delay     time.Duration
	Disabled  bool
}

Name: TabItem
Doc:
TabItem is one immutable label in Tabs. Value must be non-empty and unique
within the component.

Name: TabsProps
Doc:
TabsProps configures a controlled horizontal tab selector. Value is
authoritative; Tabs renders only the selector and applications render the
corresponding content separately.

Name: MenuOrientation
Doc: MenuOrientation selects the axis used to arrange Menu items.

Name: MenuItem
Doc:
MenuItem is one immutable action in a Menu. Value must be non-empty and
unique within the component.

Name: MenuProps
Doc:
MenuProps configures an inline action list. Value optionally identifies the
application-controlled selected item. Activating an enabled item calls
OnAction with that item's Value, including when it is already selected.
Code:
type MenuProps struct {
	Key         string
	Style       Style
	Token       ComponentToken
	States      StateStyles
	Pointer     PointerBehavior
	Orientation MenuOrientation
	Value       string
	Items       []MenuItem
	// Disabled cancels interaction and removes the focus stop.
	Disabled bool
	// OnAction invokes an enabled item, including the selected one. Nil retains navigation and visuals.
	OnAction func(string)
}

Name: Option
Doc: Option distinguishes an explicitly supplied zero value from an unset value.

Name: Point
Doc: Point is a position or offset in logical units.

Name: Size
Doc: Size is a width and height in logical units.
Code: type Size struct{ Width, Height float32 }

Name: RGBAColor
Doc:
RGBAColor is an 8-bit non-premultiplied RGBA color.

The former Color type name is now the discoverable color-token namespace.
Code: type RGBAColor struct{ R, G, B, A uint8 }

Name: RGBA
Code: func RGBA(r, g, b, a uint8) RGBAColor

Name: RendererPreference
Doc: RendererPreference selects the preferred renderer creation policy.

Name: CacheBudgets
Doc:
CacheBudgets bounds CPU and renderer-owned text, icon, and image resources. Zero
selects defaults: FontBytes 32 MiB, TextSourceBytes 2 MiB, GlyphBytes 2 MiB,
TextMeasureBytes 1 MiB, ImageBytes 2 MiB, and ShadowBytes 2 MiB. ImageBytes
bounds inactive reusable CPU pixels and renderer textures. Unique images in
the committed display are working-set resources charged at four bytes per
source pixel until that display releases them. A negative cache budget
disables that cache; negative FontBytes or TextSourceBytes permits no
application fonts or retained text/icon masks respectively.
Code:
type CacheBudgets struct {
	FontBytes        int
	TextSourceBytes  int
	GlyphBytes       int
	TextMeasureBytes int
	ImageBytes       int
	ShadowBytes      int
}

Name: AppOptions
Doc:
AppOptions configures an App's main window and shared runtime. Its
zero value selects documented window, renderer, cache, font, and theme
defaults; invalid dimensions, renderer values, fonts, or themes are reported
by App.Run before native event processing begins.

Name: WindowOptions
Doc:
WindowOptions configures an independent native child window. Theme, fonts,
renderer preference, cache budgets and App shortcuts are inherited from the
owning App. Callbacks execute on the App UI thread.

Name: ShortcutKey
Doc: ShortcutKey is a backend-neutral semantic key used by an App shortcut.

Name: KeyEnter
Code:
const (
	KeyEnter ShortcutKey = iota + 1
	KeyBackspace
	Key0
	Key1
	Key2
	Key3
	Key4
	Key5
	Key6
	Key7
	Key8
	Key9
	KeyPlus
	KeyMinus
	KeyMultiply
	KeyDivide
	KeyDecimal
	KeyEquals
)

Name: ShortcutModifiers
Doc:
ShortcutModifiers are matched exactly. Primary substitutes for Command on
macOS and Control elsewhere; callers do not also set that physical field.
Code: type ShortcutModifiers struct{ Shift, Control, Alt, Super, Primary bool }

Name: Shortcut
Doc:
Shortcut binds one application-window key chord to a semantic action.
Focused editors and built-in control keys have priority. Repeat enables
repeated key-down activation; otherwise native repeat is consumed silently.

Name: FontFamily
Doc:
FontFamily is an application-visible family name used for deterministic
ordered fallback. It is not an operating-system font handle.

Name: FontFamilyDefault
Doc:
FontFamilyDefault is dxui's embedded, BSD-licensed Go Regular font. It
covers the MVP Latin samples but not CJK.

Name: FontFamilySystemSans
Doc:
FontFamilySystemSans resolves one fixed candidate list per operating
system; it is never searched by fuzzy display name.

Name: FontFamilySystemMono
Doc: FontFamilySystemMono is the deterministic system monospace family.

Name: FontFamilySystemCJK
Doc: FontFamilySystemCJK is the deterministic system CJK fallback family.

Name: Font
Doc:
Font registers one TTF/OTF/TTC face. A FontBytes value owns its copied bytes
for as long as that value or an App configured with it remains reachable.
FontFile handles and all parsed faces live only from App.Run text startup until
renderer teardown completes. The file is not copied into the Go heap.
FaceIndex selects a collection face and is zero
for ordinary fonts.

Name: FontBytes
Doc: FontBytes creates an application-owned font from a defensive copy of data.

Name: FontFile
Doc:
FontFile creates a font loaded from the exact path during App.Run startup.
dxui does not search or copy the file into an application package.
Code: func FontFile(family FontFamily, path string) Font

Name: SystemFont
Doc:
SystemFont requests one of the documented generic system families. The
resolver tests a fixed path list for the current OS and returns a startup
error when none exists; it never depends on fontconfig or fuzzy name search.

Name: Length
Doc:
Length is an opaque automatic, logical-pixel, or percentage length. Its zero
value means automatic sizing; use Px or Percent for an explicit value.

Name: Percent
Doc: Percent creates a percentage length in the range 0..100.

Name: Fill
Doc:
Fill is the common full-available-axis length. It is equivalent to
Percent(100) and remains subject to the parent's definite-size rules.

Name: MetricValue
Doc: MetricValue is either a literal logical-unit metric or a theme token.

Name: NoShrink
Doc:
NoShrink explicitly disables flex shrinking. It is equivalent to Some(0)
and is distinct from an unset Shrink, whose default is one.

Name: Padding
Doc:
Padding applies one literal logical-unit metric to every edge. The returned
metrics are explicitly set, including when value is zero.

Name: PaddingXY
Doc:
PaddingXY applies literal logical-unit metrics to the horizontal and vertical
edges. The returned metrics are explicitly set, including zero values.

Name: Margin
Doc:
Margin applies one literal logical-unit metric to every edge, like Padding.
The returned metrics are explicitly set, including when value is zero.

Name: MarginXY
Doc:
MarginXY applies literal logical-unit metrics to the horizontal and vertical
edges, like PaddingXY. The returned metrics are explicitly set, including zero values.

Name: Round
Doc:
Round applies one literal logical-unit radius to every corner. The returned
metrics are explicitly set, including when value is zero.

Name: ColorValue
Doc: ColorValue is either a literal color or a theme token.

Name: ColorRGBA
Doc:
ColorRGBA creates an explicitly set literal paint color from RGBA channels,
including transparent zero. Use RGBA for raw RGBAColor data instead.
Code: func ColorRGBA(r, g, b, a uint8) ColorValue

Name: LiteralColor
Doc:
LiteralColor wraps existing raw RGBA data as a literal paint color.
Use ColorRGBA when supplying channels directly.

Name: TokenColor
Doc: TokenColor creates a token-backed paint color.

Name: EdgeValues
Doc:
EdgeValues contains metrics in top, right, bottom, left order. Its zero-value
fields are unset.
Code: type EdgeValues struct{ Top, Right, Bottom, Left MetricValue }

Name: Edges
Doc: Edges creates explicit logical-unit edges in top, right, bottom, left order.
Code: func Edges(top, right, bottom, left float32) EdgeValues

Name: UniformEdges
Doc: UniformEdges applies one metric to every edge.

Name: CornerValues
Doc:
CornerValues contains radii in top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left order.
Its zero-value fields are unset.
Code: type CornerValues struct{ TopLeft, TopRight, BottomRight, BottomLeft MetricValue }

Name: Corners
Doc:
Corners creates explicit logical-unit radii in top-left, top-right,
bottom-right, bottom-left order.
Code: func Corners(topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft float32) CornerValues

Name: UniformCorners
Doc: UniformCorners applies one radius to every corner.

Name: Position
Doc: Position controls normal-flow versus absolute layout.

Name: Insets
Code: type Insets struct{ Top, Right, Bottom, Left Length }

Name: AlignStart
JustifyStart
Style
Doc:
Style contains the supported layout, paint, and typography controls. Box
is always single-line; there is intentionally no wrap or order
property. The zero value is safe and selects intrinsic sizing and theme
defaults.
Code:
type Style struct {
	Width, Height       Length
	MinWidth, MinHeight Length
	MaxWidth, MaxHeight Length
	Margin, Padding     EdgeValues
	Position            Position
	Insets              Insets
	Grow                float32
	Shrink              Option[float32]
	Basis               Length
	AlignSelf           Option[Align]
	ZIndex              int
	Overflow            Overflow
	Background          ColorValue
	Border              Border
	Radius              CornerValues
	// Shadow is an explicitly requested list of outer shadows. A nil value
	// leaves a theme/state value unchanged; a non-nil empty slice removes it.
	Shadow     []Shadow
	Opacity    Option[float32]
	Visibility Visibility
	Text       TextStyle
	// Force is applied after component and interaction-state styles. It is for
	// deliberate paint overrides such as suppressing a focus ring; ordinary
	// base appearance belongs in the fields above so Hover/Pressed/Focus remain
	// visible. Force cannot affect layout.
	Force StylePatch
}

Name: Visibility
Doc: Visibility controls whether a node contributes display items.

Name: PointerBehavior
Doc: PointerBehavior controls pointer participation for a view subtree.

Name: PointerAuto
PointerNone
Doc:
PointerNone excludes the view and all descendants. It is intended for
decorative overlays that must not intercept content below them.

Name: BorderPattern
Doc: BorderPattern selects how a border is painted. The zero value is solid.

Name: BorderSides
Doc: BorderSides selects edges. Zero means all edges, not an absent border.

Name: BorderTop
Code:
const (
	BorderTop BorderSides = 1 << iota
	BorderRight
	BorderBottom
	BorderLeft
	BorderAll = BorderTop | BorderRight | BorderBottom | BorderLeft
)

Name: Border
Doc:
Border is a paint-only border drawn inside a view's layout bounds.
Each side owns the nearest half of its two adjacent corner arcs.

Name: NoBorder
Doc:
NoBorder explicitly clears the border width. In ordinary Style, later state
patches may restore a border; Style.Force is applied after those patches.

Name: Stroke
Doc: Stroke creates a solid border with a literal logical-unit width.
Code: func Stroke(width float32, color ColorValue) Border

Name: Shadow
Doc:
Shadow is an outer paint-only shadow. MVP shadows support finite,
non-negative blur/spread and are rendered by a bounded approximation.

Name: FontWeight
Doc: FontWeight selects the nearest registered face weight in a family.

Name: WeightRegular
FontSlant
Doc: FontSlant selects a registered normal or italic face.

Name: TextAlign
Doc: TextAlign is horizontal alignment within a Text node's content box.

Name: TextStart
TextStyle
Doc:
TextStyle contains the simple-LTR/CJK MVP text inputs. Families are tried in
order before the App default and built-in Latin fallback. Size is a font
size in logical units; zero uses the current theme's default. LineHeight is
a logical-unit line height; zero uses the current theme's default.
Arabic/Indic shaping, bidi/RTL, color emoji, and vertical text are not
supported by this API.
Code:
type TextStyle struct {
	Families   []FontFamily
	Size       float32
	LineHeight float32
	Weight     FontWeight
	Slant      FontSlant
	Color      ColorValue
	Align      TextAlign
}

Name: ComponentToken
Doc: ComponentToken names a component-level theme entry.

Name: PrimitiveTokens
Doc: PrimitiveTokens are the literal foundation of a theme.

Name: SemanticTokens
Doc:
SemanticTokens map product meaning onto primitive or earlier semantic
tokens. A literal ColorValue/MetricValue is also accepted.

Name: StylePatch
Doc:
StylePatch is an explicitly optional paint-only override. State styles are
intentionally paint-only in MVP, so interaction never moves layout.
Code:
type StylePatch struct {
	Background Option[ColorValue]
	Border     Option[Border]
	Radius     Option[CornerValues]
	Shadow     Option[[]Shadow]
	Opacity    Option[float32]
	Visibility Option[Visibility]
	TextColor  Option[ColorValue]
}

Name: StateStyles
Doc: StateStyles contains the deterministic MVP visual-state cascade.
Code:
type StateStyles struct {
	Default  StylePatch
	Hover    StylePatch
	Focus    StylePatch
	Disabled StylePatch
	Pressed  StylePatch
	Checked  StylePatch
}

Name: ComponentTheme
Doc: ComponentTheme supplies semantic-token-backed defaults for one component.

Name: Theme
Doc:
Theme is the public, type-safe Primitive -> Semantic -> Component token
structure. SetTheme validates and copies every map and slice atomically.

Name: Direction
Doc: Direction selects Box's main axis. Vertical is the zero value.

Name: Vertical
Doc: Vertical lays out Box children from top to bottom and is the zero value.

Name: Horizontal
Doc: Horizontal lays out Box children from left to right.

Name: BoxProps
Doc:
BoxProps configures a Box. Gap is a fixed logical-unit spacing; zero means
no spacing between children.
Code:
type BoxProps struct {
	Key     string
	Style   Style
	Token   ComponentToken
	States  StateStyles
	Pointer PointerBehavior

	Direction Direction
	Gap       float32
	Justify   Justify
	Align     Align
}

Name: ColorPrimitiveWhite
Code:
const (
	ColorPrimitiveWhite              ColorToken = "primitive.white"
	ColorPrimitiveBlack              ColorToken = "primitive.black"
	ColorPrimitiveBlue               ColorToken = "primitive.blue"
	ColorPrimitiveGray               ColorToken = "primitive.gray"
	ColorSemanticSurface             ColorToken = "semantic.surface"
	ColorSemanticSurfaceHi           ColorToken = "semantic.surface.high"
	ColorSemanticText                ColorToken = "semantic.text"
	ColorSemanticAccent              ColorToken = "semantic.accent"

Name: LightTheme
Doc:
LightTheme returns an independent, mutable-by-the-caller light theme value.
App.SetTheme copies it before use.

Name: DarkTheme
Doc: DarkTheme returns an independent, mutable-by-the-caller dark theme value.

Name: View
Doc:
View is an immutable description. Its representation is deliberately
private and never contains backend or SDL handles. The zero value is invalid
as a root or child; a failed tree update leaves the last valid view visible.

Name: View.WithKey
Doc:
WithKey returns an independent description whose sibling-local key is key.
The receiver and any descriptions that share its node are unchanged. This
does not add a container or retained identity level.

Name: View.WithStyle
Doc:
WithStyle returns an independent description whose complete local Style is
style. Replacement is intentional: zero values, nil slices, and explicit
empty slices keep their normal Style meanings. This does not add a container
or retained identity level.

Name: Box
Doc:
Box creates a single-line flex description. Direction defaults to Vertical.
Zero children are valid; a zero View among the supplied children is rejected
transactionally.

Name: Scroll
Doc: Scroll creates a clipped, one-child scrolling viewport.
Code: func Scroll(props ScrollProps, child View) View

Name: VirtualList
Doc:
VirtualList creates a vertical fixed-row virtualized viewport. The runtime
builds only the visible rows plus the configured bounded overscan.

Name: Select
Doc: Select creates a controlled custom popup Select. Options are copied.

Name: Popover
Doc:
Popover creates a controlled interactive overlay around one anchor and one
content view. The content remains retained but is painted only in the
window-level overlay layer while Open is true.
Code: func Popover(props PopoverProps, anchor, content View) View

Name: Tooltip
Doc:
Tooltip creates a delayed, non-interactive overlay around one anchor and
one content view.
Code: func Tooltip(props TooltipProps, anchor, content View) View

Name: Tabs
Doc: Tabs creates a controlled horizontal tab selector. Items are copied.

Name: Menu
Doc:
Menu creates an inline vertical or horizontal action list with an optional
controlled selected Value. Items are copied. Vertical is the zero value.

Name: Label
Doc: Label creates text with the default text style.

Name: Button
Doc: Button creates a semantic button description.
Code: func Button(props ButtonProps, child View) View

Name: TextButton
Doc:
TextButton creates a Button whose text is centered in its content box.
Use Button directly when the content is not a simple label.
Code: func TextButton(props ButtonProps, label string) View

Name: ButtonGroup
Doc:
ButtonGroup creates a non-focusable horizontal or vertical group containing
only Button views. Horizontal is the zero-value orientation.

Name: InputGroup
Doc:
InputGroup creates one horizontal visual control from a required Input and
optional prefix/suffix views. The supplied Input keeps its own identity and
editing state; the group suppresses only the Input's internal surface paint.
Code: func InputGroup(props InputGroupProps, content InputGroupContent) View

Name: Badge
Doc: Badge creates a compact, non-interactive one-child label.
Code: func Badge(props BadgeProps, child View) View

Name: ProgressBar
Doc: ProgressBar creates a deterministic, non-interactive progress indicator.

Name: ToggleSwitch
Doc: ToggleSwitch creates a controlled semantic switch description.

Name: Slider
Doc: Slider creates a controlled single-value horizontal slider description.

Name: Checkbox
Doc: Checkbox creates a controlled semantic checkbox with one label child.
Code: func Checkbox(props CheckboxProps, label View) View

Name: Radio
Doc: Radio creates a controlled semantic radio button with one label child.
Code: func Radio(props RadioProps, label View) View

Name: Icon
Doc: Icon creates a lightweight vector icon description.

Name: Image
Doc: Image creates a guarded raster image description.

Name: Avatar
Doc: Avatar creates a centered cover image with circular or square clipping.

Name: Input
Doc: Input creates a controlled, single-line input description.

Name: Textarea
Doc: Textarea creates a controlled multiline text editor description.

Name: MaxVirtualListItems
Doc: MaxVirtualListItems bounds key metadata and extent arithmetic.

Name: MaxVirtualListOverscan
Doc: MaxVirtualListOverscan bounds work retained outside the viewport.

Name: ErrWindowClosed
Doc: ErrWindowClosed reports an operation on a child window after close.
Code:
var // ErrWindowClosed reports an operation on a child window after close.
ErrWindowClosed = errors.New("dxui: window is closed")

Name: ErrWindowNotRunning
Doc: ErrWindowNotRunning reports child-window creation outside App.Run.
Code:
var // ErrWindowNotRunning reports child-window creation outside App.Run.
ErrWindowNotRunning = errors.New("dxui: window runtime is not running")

Name: Window
Doc:
Window is an opaque, concurrency-safe handle to a child native window.
Component construction remains on the root dxui API; a Window only owns
window-level lifecycle and scheduling operations.

Name: App.CreateWindow
Doc:
CreateWindow creates a hidden native child window and prepares its complete
first frame. It must be called from a UI callback or App.Update closure.
Failure releases every partially created child resource and leaves existing
windows unchanged.
Code: func (a *App) CreateWindow(options WindowOptions, root func() View) (*Window, error)

Name: Window.Update
Doc: Update queues a child-window state mutation and rebuilds only that window.

Name: Window.Invalidate
Doc: Invalidate requests a rebuild of only this child window.

Name: Window.SetTitle
Doc:
SetTitle changes the native title on the UI thread. It may be called from a
UI callback or App.Update closure and does not rebuild the root.

Name: Window.SetSize
Doc:
SetSize requests a new positive logical client size. The resulting native
viewport event drives layout; it is not presented speculatively.

Name: Window.Title
Doc: Title returns the last successfully configured title.

Name: Window.Size
Doc:
Size returns the latest known logical client size. Native resize events and
successful SetSize calls update this snapshot.

Name: Window.Maximize
Doc: Maximize requests the platform's maximized window state.

Name: Window.Unmaximize
Doc: Unmaximize restores a maximized window to its normal state.

Name: Window.Minimize
Doc: Minimize requests the platform's minimized window state.

Name: Window.Unminimize
Doc: Unminimize restores a minimized window to its normal state.

Name: Window.IsMaximized
Doc: IsMaximized reports the latest state confirmed by native window events.

Name: Window.IsMinimized
Doc: IsMinimized reports the latest state confirmed by native window events.

Name: App.Title
Doc: Main-window counterparts preserve App as the main lifecycle handle.

Name: Window.Close
Doc:
Close closes this child window without affecting its owner or siblings.
Repeated calls are no-ops.

Name: Window.Diagnostics
Doc: Diagnostics returns this window's backend-neutral counters.

Name: Window.Closed
Doc: Closed reports whether close has been requested or completed.

Name: Entry
Doc: Entry maps a Lucide kebab-case name and Go constructor name to its lazy icon constructor.

Name: Icons
Doc: Icons contains all canonical icons and aliases. Importing catalog intentionally makes the full library reachable.

Name: Point
Doc: Point is a position in icon view-box coordinates.
Code: type Point struct{ X, Y float32 }

Name: Rect
Doc: Rect is a rectangle in icon view-box coordinates.
Code: type Rect struct{ X, Y, Width, Height float32 }

Name: PathVerb
Doc: PathVerb identifies one vector path command.

Name: PathMove
Code:
const (
	PathMove PathVerb = iota
	PathLine
	PathQuad
	PathCubic
	PathClose
)

Name: PathCommand
Doc: PathCommand stores up to three points.

Name: PaintMode
Doc: PaintMode identifies whether a packed path is filled or stroked.

Name: Path
Doc: Path is one decoded path with a single paint mode.

Name: Data
Doc:
Data is immutable when returned by Packed. Commands remains exported for
compatibility with application-authored filled icons; callers own that
slice and dxui copies it when constructing a View.

Name: Data.IsPacked
Doc: IsPacked reports whether data uses the immutable generated representation.

Name: Data.Identity
Doc: Identity returns a stable content identity without exposing packed bytes.

Name: Data.Paths
Doc: Paths validates and decodes data. Legacy Commands form one filled path.
